key_foreman.name: The Foreman's Key
key_foreman.description: Opens the assembly hall. The fob is a clocking-in card with the corner cut off, which is what they did when a man left.

foremans_diary.name: The Foreman's Diary
foremans_diary.description: A works diary, kept daily in pencil. It stops on a Tuesday and the following pages have been used for sums.
